newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower as recovery falters.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower as recovery falters.

text.p: Czech major issues faltered on Wednesday after a two day upsurge had raised hopes that the long and steady downtrend on the Prague bourse may have come to an end.
The PX50 lost 0.44 percent to 518.2 led by the two most heavily captalised shares, SPT Telecom and CEZ.

"The earlier gains, this was purely speculation. I would say that the periods of the market going up will be very short and the intervels between them longer and longer," said Radek Vavra of Citicorp Securities.
Vavra said that the main factor behind the sustained downtrend was the current state of the Czech economy.

In the first three months of the year, official figures showed real industrial output falling 4.2 percent compared with the first quarter of 1996 while construction output fell 5.2 percent in the same period.
